# netactuate_sshkey (Resource)

Manages a Sshkey.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_sshkey" "example" {
  key  = "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIEexamplekeyexamplekeyexamplekeyexamplekey example"
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `name` (String) Display name for the object.

### Optional

- `last_updated` (String) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_sshkey.example 12345
```
